_meta.identity_contract: node identity = (tree_class, node_id); path_id kept; names are presentation

source.build_provenance: ABSENT: the raw tree dump carries no GameAssembly hash; it cannot be proven to come from 1.4.6 build 22986002
source.decoder_defect: legacy decoder read one u32 where SkillTreeNode serializes two lists (nodeStats, stats); nodes with empty stats have text fields shifted by one

failure_join.note: failure records were produced by a different walker run than the raw dump (tree path ids differ); joined by tree class. Mixed-run raw inputs are a provenance defect (R1.2).

_meta.stat_property_contract: stats[].property keeps the raw id and a reference classification (RESOLVED / UNRESOLVED / AMBIGUOUS / UNKNOWN_PROPERTY_TYPE) from the bands validated in exports_canonical/property_definitions.json
_meta.stat_value_contract: stats[].value_text is the tooltip text the walker decoded; numeric node stats (SkillTreeNode.nodeStats) are not decoded by the current walker
